title: COME401: Program Delivery Coordinator
description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions. JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.
Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K-12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.
Overview
This is a pro-bono volunteer position.
JerseySTEM provides free after school STEM classes to underserved middle school girls grade 5-8.
The Program Delivery Coordinator makes sure the logistics of the program are running smoothly during the 10 weeks of the class. She/He is the regular contact to the Program Instructors and the School Liaison. The After school- Program Delivery Coordinator ensures that the weekly outreach programs in their area of responsibility are scheduled to run each work, have needed resources, answer questions, and troubleshoot problems.
This is a virtual position that supports in-person STEM enrichment programs for middle school girls/kids and needs to be available from 3 pm-5 pm ( Wednesday or Thursday) at least one weekday over a 12 week period of time.
Responsibilities

• Develop report with the School Liaison (school employee) and be their single point of contact at JerseySTEM

• Communicate on a weekly basis with the Program Instructors

• Solve issues related to:

• Uber/Transportation of the Program Instructors

• School Supplies if any

• Attendance

• Attend virtual team meetings weekly : (Sundays 6pm-6:30pm EST)

Qualifications

• Genuine concern about/interest in solving the STEM education gender gap

• Ability to establish and maintain connections with school personnel

• Ability to connect/communicate relate with college students using their modes of communication: Discord, Slack, SMS

• Resourceful, can-do attitude

• Experience with K-12 schools as a parent, former student professionally

• Outreach experience preferred

• Comfort working in a ‘virtual organization’ with digital tools (G-Suite, Slack, Jira, salesforce)

• Would be a plus if candidate has flexible schedule to allow for day time calls with the school admins during the work week

Time Commitment

• 3-6 Hours weekly

• 6 months minimum

title: Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin Texas, New York, San Francisco

About the Team

The Strategy organization operates as a high-velocity engine at the intersection of business, technology, and go-to-market execution, driving enterprise growth, global expansion, market innovation, and strategic execution. Our multi-disciplinary team spans seven core strategic pillars: Network & Infrastructure Strategy, Industry Solutions, Strategic Partnerships, International Expansion, Executive Customer Engagements, Corporate Development & M&A, and the new business model of the Internet. As primary connective tissue across the enterprise, we collaborate closely with Sales, Product & Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Policy to translate corporate vision into measurable, real-world execution.

Role Summary

As a Senior Strategic Partner Manager, you will work directly with Product, Engineering, and executive leadership to identify, build, and launch key partnerships that accelerate our product roadmap and drive platform adoption.

The initiatives you own will span strategic co-build integrations, OEM relationships, and complex GTM alliance build-outs. This is a hands-on execution role for a versatile problem-solver-you will own partnerships end-to-end, moving from initial strategic alignment through technical scoping, contract negotiation, integration, and go-to-market launch.

You will flex across different technology domains as company priorities shift, diving into technical details, validating integration use cases, and bringing cross-functional teams (Legal, Security, GTM, Finance) together to deliver real outcomes.

• Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships (technology integrations, ecosystem plays, and go-to-market alliances) across Cloudflare's product areas, prioritizing based on where the business needs it most.

• Partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders to assess technical fit, integration approach, and roadmap alignment for prospective partnerships.

• Build the business case for each partnership: sizing the opportunity, validating the underlying use case, and making a clear, evidence-based recommendation on whether to pursue it.

• Lead negotiation and execution end-to-end, from initial scoping through signed agreement and launch.

title: Customer Success Manager, Law Firms
description:
Location: Remote
Travel required: 20-25%

We're Proof , a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role

We're looking for a commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own retention and growth across a portfolio of law-firm customers. You'll build executive relationships, spot expansion opportunities, and grow Proof's share of wallet, protecting and growing revenue rather than just keeping the lights on. This is a revenue-accountable role, not a support or onboarding seat, and you'll work closely with Account Executives to turn new logos into long-term, growing partnerships.

What You'll Do

• You'll own retention and growth across your portfolio of law-firm customers, protecting revenue and growing Proof's share of wallet.

• You'll identify whitespace across offices, attorneys, practice areas, and jurisdictions, and turn it into expansion revenue.

• You'll build multi-threaded relationships with firm owners, managing partners, and operations leaders, and lead strategic business reviews on outcomes and growth.

• You'll monitor volume, revenue, and sentiment to catch risk early, and partner with Account Executives to ramp new logos into sustained production.

• You'll maintain an evidence-based expansion pipeline and portfolio forecast, coordinating escalations while keeping customers and internal teams aligned.

What You'll Bring

• You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, sales, or another commercial customer-facing role.

• You have a track record of turning account insight into qualified, closed expansion revenue, not just retention.

• You build credibility with firm owners and managing partners, not just your day-to-day contact.

• You're comfortable traveling 20-25% of the time for onsite customer visits, events, and internal meetings.

• You treat customer success as revenue protection and growth, and you own your commitments end to end.

Bonus points: experience with law firms, legal technology, or usage-based/consumption revenue models is a plus.

Compensation

• Compensation: $130,000-$150,000 OTE

Benefits

The role of a Senior CRO Copywriter focuses on creating persuasive, conversion-driven copy with the primary goal of improving marketing performance and conversion rates. This involves developing compelling copy for landing pages, ads, video scripts, and other marketing assets that attract cold audiences and encourage them to take action.
The CRO Copywriter works closely with marketing, creative, and testing teams to develop and optimize messaging based on customer research, campaign performance, and A/B testing results. Requirements

• Native-level English.

• Strong understanding of direct-response principles, customer psychology, and conversion-focused writing.

• Proven experience writing landing pages, paid advertising copy, and performance creative.

• Strong ability to develop headlines, hooks, offers, CTAs, value propositions, and messaging angles.

• Experience writing for cold audiences and customer acquisition campaigns.

• Ability to quickly research and understand unfamiliar products, markets, and customer segments.

• Ability to translate features and technical information into clear customer benefits.

• Experience creating structured copy variations for A/B testing.

• Comfortable reviewing marketing performance data and using results to improve copy.

• Strong attention to detail, grammar, proofreading, and consistency.

• Ability to manage multiple clients, niches, and projects simultaneously.

• Experience using AI tools for research, copy development, analysis, and workflow optimization.

• Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches.

title: Remote Clinical Validation Reviewer (RN)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides support for inpatient and outpatient clinical claim review activities. Verifies that coded diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, and corresponding reimbursement methodologies accurately reflect the member's documented clinical condition, services rendered, and billed charges. Assesses medical records for clinical accuracy, acuity alignment, and documentation integrity. Identifies inconsistencies that impact reimbursement such as unsupported diagnoses, incorrect procedure coding, or inaccurate revenue code assignment and determines whether billed services meet coding and billing guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements. Contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.
Essential Job Duties

• Reviews inpatient and/or outpatient claims to ensure diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, itemized charges, and Diagnostic Related Groups (DRG) assignments accurately reflect the documented clinical condition and services provided.
• Integrates ICD‑10 coding principles, DRG methodologies, revenue code logic, and evidence‑based clinical guidelines when reviewing claims for accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with documentation.
• Performs DRG validation reviews by verifying principal and secondary diagnoses, complications/comorbidities, procedure coding, severity level, and correct grouping logic.
• Conducts itemized bill reviews to confirm that charges are supported by clinical documentation, compliant with billing standards, and appropriate for the level of care delivered; identifies unsupported, inaccurate, or inappropriate coding or billing elements such as unsubstantiated diagnoses, incorrect procedures, or incorrect revenue code usage.
• Develops clear, evidence‑based written rationales supporting diagnosis, procedure, revenue code, or DRG recommendations and determinations.
• Substantiates all review outcomes using clinical indicators, documentation, coding guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements.
• Performs review work independently, applying sound clinical judgment and specialized expertise to evaluate complex claim scenarios.
• Applies applicable federal/state regulations, official coding guidelines, payer policies, and Molina payment integrity standards during all reviews.
• Ensures compliance with DRG and itemized bill review criteria, clinical validation rules, and reimbursement methodologies.
• Collaborates with coding, payment integrity analytics, SIU, and physician advisors to clarify complex clinical documentation, coding discrepancies, or reimbursement determinations.
• Provides subject matter expertise on DRG validation, revenue code accuracy, itemized bill review, and documentation integrity to internal partners as needed.
• Meets or exceeds established productivity goals set by payment integrity leadership for clinical validation and claim review activities.
• Achieves the required accuracy and quality standards for review, diagnosis/procedure validation, and/or itemized bill reviews.
• Participates in quality checks, calibration sessions, and ongoing training to maintain consistency and strengthen review competency.
• Completes special projects and additional review assignments as delegated by leadership. Identifies patterns and trends in documentation, coding, or billing that may require internal escalation, provider education, or process improvement.
• Supports continuous improvement efforts by contributing insights that enhance review processes, criteria application, and workflow efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of experience in inpatient payment integrity medical claim review including DRG validation or itemized bill review, and experience working with ICD-10, MS-DRG, AP-DRG and APR-DRG, CPT, HCPCS, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Registered Nurse (RN). License must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.

• Advanced in DRG methodologies.

title: Manager, Talent Account Management
description:
Overview
Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth
The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close. The TAMs own the hiring manager relationship and the candidate experience once a candidate enters an active process. This Manager makes sure that work is focused on the right roles, delivered to a consistent standard, and measured in a way the business can trust.
The role is accountable for delivery outcomes, reporting, customer satisfaction and escalations. It works from the priority order set jointly with the Capacity Planning Manager, so that TAM time goes to the roles that matter most to i2G's contracts and markets. It operates on Kastle Systems' talent platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed) and draws its candidate supply from Kastle's Sourcing team.
This is a leadership and delivery role, not a sourcing role and not a demand-planning role. It does not own the demand forecast, which sits with the Capacity Planning Manager. It does not own top-of-funnel sourcing, which sits with Kastle's Sourcing team. It owns what happens between those two: turning qualified leads into hires, and doing it well.
Reporting and working relationships

•
Chief Operating Officer, i2G (direct). Sets business priorities for the team, evaluates performance and is the escalation point for delivery and resourcing issues.

•
Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, Kastle Systems (indirect). Sets recruiting process standards, platform usage and compliance expectations, and partners on team practices and reporting.

•
Capacity Planning Manager, i2G (peer). Owns the labor demand forecast and the rolling requisition priority order. The two roles agree together where TAM effort goes each month.

•
Kastle Sourcing team (upstream partner). Supplies sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs. This Manager owns the quality feedback loop back to Sourcing.

•
i2G hiring managers and branch leadership (customers). The people the TAMs serve. This Manager is the senior point of contact for their satisfaction and their escalations.

Responsibilities
Key responsibilities
1. Team leadership and coaching

• Lead, coach and develop three Talent Account Managers. Set clear expectations, run regular one-to-ones and case reviews, and give direct performance feedback.

• Assign requisition portfolios to TAMs based on priority, complexity, market and workload, and rebalance as demand shifts.

• Set and audit the standard for the TAM role: intake quality, screening rigor, submittal quality, interview coordination, feedback turnaround, offer preparation and close.

• Coach TAMs on running difficult conversations with hiring managers, including pushing back on unrealistic requirements or slow decisions.

• Hire, onboard and backfill TAMs as needed, and maintain a development path for the team.

2. Prioritization and alignment with capacity planning

• Work with the Capacity Planning Manager as the single point of alignment between operations demand and TAM delivery.

• Run the team from the rolling 90-day requisition forecast and its agreed priority order. Confirm each month which roles get TAM focus first.

• Make sure TAM effort follows priority, not volume of requests or the loudest hiring manager. Flag when priorities conflict or when demand exceeds what the team can deliver.

• Take part in the monthly talent acquisition and operations review with data, recommendations and follow-through on decisions.

• Raise early warning when a priority role is at risk, including the revenue or delivery consequence, so trade-offs are made with full information.

3. Hiring manager partnership and customer satisfaction

• Own the operating relationship with i2G hiring managers and branch leadership at the leadership level, and hold the TAMs to a consistent service standard.

• Set and enforce an intake standard so every requisition has a clear profile, priority, compensation range and interview plan befo

- Get It Done - You thrive

• Ability to withstand walking, lifting, bending, stooping, climbing ladders, walking on roofs, and working in confined spaces.

• Basic computer skills.

• Ability to read and understand drawings,

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Implicit Signals
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team builds classification and evaluation systems that give post-training and research teams fast, reliable feedback on model behavior. We combine machine learning and production engineering to make these capabilities accurate, efficient, and useful at scale, helping researchers assess changes and improve models and products.

We work closely with research teams to develop useful measurements and make them practical to run. Our work spans classifier development, rigorous evaluation, and efficient production inference, with ownership from initial experimentation through deployment and continued improvement.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a machine learning engineer to develop new classification and evaluation capabilities and bring them into production. You’ll help turn open-ended questions about model behavior into well-defined ML problems, build methods that address them, and establish how reliably those methods work.

This role combines traditional machine learning, model evaluation, and real-time engineering. You’ll own classifiers throughout their lifecycle, including supervised fine-tuning, distillation, evaluation, deployment, and production inference. You’ll work closely with researchers to identify valuable problems and with software engineers to make promising approaches useful at scale.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build, deploy, and operate production classification and evaluation systems that provide useful feedback to post-training and research teams.

- Optimize production inference, including model serving, batching, caching, throughput, latency, compute utilization, and cost.

- Train and optimize classifiers using supervised fine-tuning and distillation, validating quality and efficiency before deployment.

- Own the reliability and observability of deployed classifiers, diagnose production issues, and improve their performance over time.

- Design rigorous evaluations that assess accuracy, calibration, generalization, and potential measurement bias while guiding production tradeoffs.

- Partner with software engineers to integrate models into reliable execution systems and support safe rollouts.

- Build reusable engineering tools that make classifier training, evaluation, deployment, and iteration faster and more repeatable.

- Work with post-training researchers and data scientists to translate their needs into modeling objectives, evaluation criteria, and production requirements.

YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK SOMETHING LIKE

- Experience taking ML projects from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment.

- Strong foundations in supervised learning, statistics, and experimental design.

- Practical experience evaluating models, investigating systematic errors, and working with imperfect labels.

- Strong software engineering skills and the ability to build maintainable production ML systems.

- Experience reasoning about inference performance and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and compute cost.

- The ability to combine careful scientific judgment with a practical approach to shipping and operating software.

- Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers on open-ended problems.

- Fluency in using AI agents to move quickly across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience with model distillation, representation learning, calibration, or efficient inference is a plus.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

• Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)

• When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)

• Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

• Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

• Train, fine-tune and distill draft models, and design rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses.

Preferred Qualifications

This person will be a strategic thought partner and hands-on operator who is equally comfortable thinking big-picture with senior leadership and getting into the weeds to build the systems, models, and processes that let the org run on real data. ABOUT US

We’re building the next generation of the TV operating system, reimagining the experience at the intersection of television, streaming, and how people discover and search.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Designer who thinks in systems, questions assumptions, and can solve problems that don’t have an established answer.

This is a hands-on role spanning product thinking, interaction design, and visual design. You’ll help define the structure and behavior of our TV operating system, where AI is woven throughout the experience, taking ideas from early concepts and user flows through prototypes, polished interfaces, and implementation.

You should be as comfortable thinking about the big picture as you are getting deep into the details. One day, you might define how a new product experience should work; the next, you might prototype an interaction, refine elements of our design system, or test a concept with users.

You’ll report to our Head of Design and collaborate closely with the founder, engineers, and marketing team. Beyond making excellent work, you’ll help define what great design looks like and contribute to a culture where design is central to how we build.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own product design from early exploration and user flows through interaction design, prototyping, final UI, and implementation support

- Help define the right problems to solve, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints

- Shape core experiences across our TV operating system

- Design for the realities of TV, with clear hierarchy, readable interfaces, and thoughtful voice first remote navigation and focus states

- Build interactive prototypes to explore product behavior, communicate ideas, and test assumptions before development

- Use research, usability testing, product data, and feedback to inform decisions and improve experiences

- Evolve our design system, creating reusable components and patterns that help the team move quickly without lowering the bar

- Partner closely with engineers throughout development, working through edge cases and ensuring the shipped experience reflects the design intent

YOU

- 5+ years of experience

- Have experience designing and shipping products, at a startup, agency, or similarly fast-moving environment

- Can turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, intuitive experiences

- Have a strong command of typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Think beyond individual screens to consider complete journeys, interaction patterns, accessibility, and edge cases

- Are proficient in Figma and comfortable working with tokens, components, design systems

- Have strong instincts but welcome feedback, evidence, and better ideas

- Are autonomous and comfortable making progress when the path is not fully defined

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience designing for TV, streaming, connected devices, or remote-based interfaces

title: Federal Compliance Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is looking for a Federal Compliance Lead to build and run our federal compliance program from the ground up. As we grow across civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies, you will make sure every government deal meets federal acquisition, security, and ethics requirements while keeping deals moving. You will partner closely with our Federal sales team, Deal Desk, Legal, Engineering, and Security, and you will own the policies, processes, and guidance that let Factory sell to the U.S. government with confidence.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Build Factory’s Federal Compliance Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain Factory’s public sector sales compliance program from the ground up, establishing policies, standard operating procedures, and monitoring mechanisms for government deals.

- Accelerate Factory’s Federal Transactions: Partner directly with Federal Account Executives and Deal Desk from opportunity qualification through award. Review RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs for compliance obligations, flow-down clauses, commercial item determinations (FAR Part 12), and contractual risk.

- Enforce Statutory and Regulatory Standards: Ensure comprehensive compliance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Procurement Integrity Act, Trade Agreements Act (TAA), Buy American Act, and NDAA Section 889.

- Bridge Product, Security, and Public Sector Standards: Partner closely with Engineering and Security to align Factory’s product roadmap with federal certifications and authorization requirements, including ITAR, FIPS, SOC FedRAMP, DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG / IL levels), and NIST SP 800-53 / 800-171 controls.

- Govern Ethics and Integrity Programs: Administer company-wide federal ethics guidelines, managing organizational conflicts of interest (OCI), post-government employment restrictions, anti-kickback policies, and gift/entertainment rules for public sector interactions.

- Monitor Emerging Federal AI Policy: Track federal AI governance directives (including OMB memos and agency-specific AI acquisition guidelines) and Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) mandates, translating evolving policy into actionable operational guidance.

QUALIFICATIONS

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. description:
Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren.

- Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind.

- Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung.

- Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln.

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab.

- Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele.

title: Senior Content Writer, B2B and Technical
description:

Big Human is a full-service digital product agency in New York City. Since 2010 we’ve built 262 websites, 80 applications and 50 brands, and our work has been recognized by TIME, the Webby Awards, the Shorty Awards and Digiday. Our marketing team runs strategy, content, SEO/AEO and paid media for our clients and for Big Human itself.
The role
We’re hiring a senior writer to produce website and marketing content for our clients, with a focus on complex B2B and enterprise technology. This means product pages, solution pages, industry pages and educational content for companies whose buyers range from the people using the software every day to the executives signing off on it.
We use Claude for a lot of the heavy lifting in content production. You’ll use it to get to a strong first draft fast, then do the work that makes the content good: checking every claim, sharpening the language, protecting what the page needs to rank, and making sure the reader feels understood instead of talked at.

This is a part-time role for 10-20 hours/week. Our ideal candidate has working hours between 10 am and 6 pm EST Monday-Friday.
What you’ll do

• Write and edit high volumes of website content across reusable page templates, working in sprints with clear weekly deliverables

• Use Claude and our established content workflows to produce first drafts, then edit them into publishable copy

• Turn technical products into plain language that a buyer can understand, without losing accuracy

• Tailor messaging by audience: company size (enterprise, mid-market, small business) and buyer role (daily user, budget owner, executive)

• Fact-check product and capability claims against source material and subject-matter experts, and flag anything that can’t be verified

• Optimize content for search and AI answer engines using Clearscope, keyword targets and AEO structure (direct answers, FAQs, scannable formatting)

• Work with client product marketers and other subject-matter experts, merge their feedback into our structure, and make the case for what should stay and why

• Present editorial decisions, explaining what changed and why it’s better

• Partner with designers by delivering headlines and structure early so design and content move in parallel

What you bring

• 5+ years of B2B content writing, ideally for enterprise software, SaaS or another technical category

• Strong editing instincts. You can tell when a confident draft is wrong, vague or generic, and you know how to fix it

• Experience writing with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your production process, and a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t

• Working knowledge of SEO and AEO: keyword targeting, search intent and structuring content for both people and AI search

• Comfort learning a complex product or industry quickly, through documentation, demos and interviews

• The confidence to push back on a client rewrite, and the judgment to know when to give ground

• Plain, direct writing. No jargon, no filler, no agency-speak

• Experience managing multiple projects and hitting deadlines on a sprint schedule

Nice to have

• Background in supply chain, logistics, fintech, legal tech or another operationally complex industry

title: Copy of Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About Audien Hearing

Audien Hearing is on a mission to make hearing affordable, accessible, and stigma-free for everyone. Proudly serving over 1 million customers, we lead the way in the over-the-counter (OTC) hearing aid industry by combining innovative technology with a direct-to-consumer model. Our team is passionate about building high-impact products that empower individuals to reconnect with the world around them-at a fraction of traditional hearing aid costs.

Full Stack Software Engineer

Data-Powered Web Applications

About the Role

We're hiring a full stack engineer to build data powered web applications on top of our CX and marketing data stack. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, application development, and analytics. You'll own features end to end, from piping raw event data into our warehouse to shipping polished, AI-driven user-facing products.

If you love writing SQL as much as you love writing React, and you're excited by the idea of turning messy behavioral and marketing data into tools people actually use, this is for you.

What You'll Do

You'll build and ship full stack applications in React and Next.js deployed on Vercel, backed by Snowflake and supporting data infrastructure. On any given week you might be architecting a new customer-facing dashboard, writing complex SQL across rich CX and marketing data streams, building ETL pipelines that land clean data in Snowflake, standing up reverse ETL flows that push modeled data back into operational systems, or wiring LLM capabilities into product surfaces so that non-technical teammates can get answers from data conversationally. Dashboarding work in Omni is also part of the mix, both building dashboards directly and building web experiences that embed or extend them.

What We're Looking For

• Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, and SQL . You can move fluidly between frontend components, API routes, and warehouse queries.

• Comfort deploying and operating on Vercel .

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse), including schema design, performance tuning, and writing non-trivial analytical SQL.

• Experience building ETL pipelines to ingest data from SaaS sources, event streams, and APIs into a warehouse.

• Experience with reverse ETL patterns to sync warehouse data back out to marketing, CX, or operational tools.

• Ability to design and build dashboards and data visualizations , ideally in Omni (or tools like Looker, Hex, Mode).

• A track record of shipping production web applications, not just prototypes.

Nice to Haves

• Experience integrating LLMs or agentic AI into production apps (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, RAG, tool use, embeddings, vector search).

• Prior work on AI-powered internal tools, conversational analytics, or natural language to SQL interfaces.

• Familiarity with modern data stack tooling like dbt and Fivetran .

• Experience working with CX platforms such as Kustomer, Five9, and Salesforce .

• Experience with marketing platforms such as Klaviyo .

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

Summary of role:

AI Infrastructure Engineer will build and run the GPU and accelerator platform our AI workloads depend on. That covers the clusters and schedulers underneath, training and inference serving on top, and the observability and cost data that tell us how well the fleet is used. The role will write production code every day and own systems end to end, from design through on-call.

Representative projects

- Stand up a multi-cloud GPU fleet spanning hyperscalers, neoclouds and on-prem, orchestrated through custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators so researchers never have to think about where their job lands.

- Build a scheduling layer with gang scheduling, bin-packing and fair-share quotas that measurably raises accelerator utilization across teams.

- Ship a high-throughput vLLM serving stack with prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload and FP8/FP4 quantization. Back it with a benchmarking and traffic-replay harness that tracks TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles against per-config baselines.

- Build a self-healing health-check and remediation system that rides out fault storms across hardware, network and software without paging a human.

- Build an end-to-end cost-attribution pipeline. It ingests utilization, occupancy and billing data into the warehouse, attributes every GPU-hour to a team and workload, and drives capacity planning.

- Build internal tools and dashboards that researchers and non-engineers use every day.

 

Responsibilities:

- Design, deploy and operate GPU clusters across AWS, GCP, and other hyperscalers/neoclouds/on-premise data centers, including custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators and the metadata services behind them.

- Build scheduling that keeps accelerators busy: gang scheduling for distributed jobs, bin-packing to reduce fragmentation, and quotas and fair share for multi-tenant teams.

- Run distributed training infrastructure on PyTorch Distributed, Ray, or Megatron, with fast checkpointing and model loading.

- Deploy and tune high-throughput LLM serving with vLLM or similar: tensor and model/expert parallelism, prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload, FP8/FP4 quantization.

- Build benchmarking and traffic-replay tools that measure TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles, and set per-config performance baselines.

- Build health checks across hardware, network and software layers, and automated remediation that handles fault storms without human intervention.

- Instrument fleet utilization with DCGM, Prometheus and Grafana. Write recording rules and alerts that teams rely on.

- Ingest utilization, occupancy and billing data into a warehouse, attribute spend to teams and workloads, and support capacity planning.

- Drive autoscaling, rightsizing and idle-capacity recovery programs with measurable cost results.

- Write clear runbooks and documentation, and explain infrastructure tradeoffs to researchers, finance and leadership.

title: Field Sales Specialist
description:
Ciao. Noi siamo Teya.

Teya è nata da una semplice convinzione: le attività locali meritano di meglio. Sono i caffè, i ristoranti, i saloni, i negozi e gli imprenditori che danno carattere alle nostre strade principali, creano posti di lavoro e mantengono vive le comunità. Eppure, per troppo tempo, i servizi finanziari hanno reso loro la vita più difficile, con strumenti macchinosi, un supporto scadente e una complessità che ostacola la gestione di un'azienda.

Teya esiste per cambiare tutto questo. Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma finanziaria per le attività locali in tutta Europa, incentrata su strumenti semplici, un design curato e un supporto umano reale. I nostri Membri contano su di noi per gestire la loro attività con sicurezza, e questa responsabilità modella il nostro modo di lavorare. Ci muoviamo velocemente. Ci importa della qualità. Curiamo i dettagli. E crediamo che grandi prestazioni e autentica ospitalità debbano andare di pari passo. Se vuoi creare prodotti significativi, risolvere problemi reali e fare la differenza per le attività locali, ci farebbe molto piacere conoscerti.

Teya è una delle Fintech in più rapida crescita in Europa, che ogni giorno supporta migliaia di attività locali. Siamo un'azienda di pagamenti e software che aiuta le piccole imprese a crescere. Crediamo che il commercio locale sia il cuore pulsante delle nostre comunità e siamo qui per offrire ai commercianti gli strumenti e il supporto che meritano per competere con i grandi player.

Mentre continuiamo a crescere, stiamo espandendo il nostro team di field sales e siamo alla ricerca di candidati motivati, orientati alle persone e focalizzati sui risultati che vogliano unirsi alla nostra operatività. Se ti piace entrare in contatto con le persone, prosperi in un ambiente dinamico e frenetico e vuoi crescere in un'azienda che sta rivoluzionando i pagamenti locali, questo è il posto che fa per te!

 

La nostra Cultura:

Questi cinque valori definiscono il nostro modo di lavorare ogni giorno:

- Orgogliosi di servire: Siamo al fianco delle piccole e locali imprese.

- Costruire dal futuro: Creiamo oggi ciò che verrà domani.

- Semplicità: Diamo valore alla chiarezza, all'efficienza e alla tecnologia intelligente.

- Mentalità vincente: Puntiamo in alto e offriamo l'eccellenza.

- Un Sogno. Una Squadra. Una Voce: La collaborazione ci rende più forti.

 

LA TUA MISSIONE:

- Identificazione dei clienti: Individua in modo proattivo potenziali clienti nella tua zona attraverso attività di prospecting, lead generation, networking e referral.

- Creazione di relazioni: Incontra di persona i clienti attuali e potenziali per comprenderne le sfide, sviluppare empatia e stabilire un rapporto di fiducia offrendo un'esperienza positiva.

- Chiusura: Utilizza strategie di vendita efficaci per acquisire nuovi clienti e raggiungere costantemente i tuoi obiettivi.

- Conoscenza del prodotto: Diventa un esperto di tutto ciò che riguarda Teya e la nostra suite di prodotti (non preoccuparti, riceverai una formazione approfondita!).

- Feedback di mercato: Collabora con il resto dell'azienda fornendo preziosi approfondimenti sul campo ("boots-on-the-ground") per contribuire a migliorare i nostri prodotti.

- Fedeltà del cliente: Mantieni relazioni durature con i clienti, individuando opportunità di up-selling e cross-selling delle soluzioni Teya per massimizzare il valore e la retention.

- Rappresentanza del brand: Agisci come il volto di Teya nel tuo territorio, incarnando i nostri valori e la nostra visione.

 

LE TUE RESPONSABILITÀ:

- Attività sul campo per l'acquisizione di nuovi clienti all'interno del tuo territorio assegnato;

- Partecipazione alle riunioni mattutine del team per definire i piani, stabilire gli obiettivi e condividere le esperienze;

- Gestione di un portafoglio clienti attivo e delle attività post-vendita;

- Offrire un servizio clienti eccellente e personalizzato.

La tua missione non è solo chiudere contratti, ma creare partners

Our model prioritizes consistency, trust, and accessibility in systems where they are too often missing.

You will be one of the first prescribers in a new psychiatry service designed specifically for youth in and around foster care. Clinical care

• Build treatment plans that pair medication with the evidence-based therapy each patient receives from their HNH therapist.

• Review and simplify complex medication regimens, which many of our patients arrive with after multiple placements and prescribers.

• Prescribe electronically, including controlled substances through EPCS where permitted, and check state PDMPs as required.

• Give caregivers clear, practical guidance on diagnoses, medications, side effects, and warning signs.
